title: Diagnosis findings v1
description: What the analysis engine returns and what the one-page report renders. Shared by the internal daily mining caller and the customer diagnosis caller; neither may add sinks to this shape.

label.description: What was analysed, in the customer's words. Never an internal id.

contentIncluded.description: False under the metadata-only default. Renders on page one of the report.

coverage.description: What the trace could not answer. This is a first-class result, not an appendix.

capabilities.description: Keyed by the traces capability ids: token-accounting, cost-attribution, tool-usage, loop-convergence, tree-comparison, steering-chain, latency-analysis.

reason.description: Required when unavailable. The trace's own reason, not a guess.

skipped.description: Analyses not run, each with why. An empty array asserts nothing was skipped.

redaction.description: What was removed before any model read the spans.

consequence.description: What it costs the customer in their terms: money, latency, failed runs, human escalations.

measure.description: The number, when there is one. Absent means the finding is qualitative and the report must say so.

denominator.description: What the value is out of. A rate without a denominator is not reportable.

evidence.description: Verbatim span ids. Ids that do not resolve against the artifact are rejected upstream, never guessed.

reproduce.description: The exact command the customer runs to see this themselves.

confidence.description: observed = read directly off the trace. inferred = a model's reading of it.
